source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
In your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) (not in battle round 1), you can pick 1 **NECRONS INFANTRY** unit of yours that is either on the battlefield or in **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)**. A unit picked from the battlefield is removed and put into [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves).

The picked unit may then make an **ingress move**, during which:

- it must be set up **unengaged** and wholly within 6" of the Monolith, instead of the usual more than 8" horizontally away from every enemy unit
- it may be set up inside the enemy deployment zone

That unit is barred from **[Charge moves](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move)** this turn.

detail.timing: own Movement phase, excluding battle round one
detail.ifOnBattlefield: remove unit and put into Strategic Reserves
